mesh_handoff.coordinates: 2D: label,x,y (a third coordinate is accepted with one warning and ignored, read_nodes_.f90:115-121); 3D: exactly label,x,y,z
mesh_handoff.element_lines: <=256 characters per line; otherwise split into exactly two lines whose field counts differ
mesh_handoff.labels: positive int32, unique (per part), and every node label must equal its position in input order (1..N, ascending, no gaps): node-set members are stored as labels (src/input/read_set_.f90:405-433) and labels from node sets and element connectivities are used directly as positions in nodes%no (e.g. src/soe/soe_apply_boundary_conditions_.f90:119-120, src/fem/fem_global_assemble_loads_.f90:626-631, src/fem/fem_global_gather_and_scatter_.f90:77, src/database/element_ty_.f90:301 with src/main.f90:244, src/output/VTK_write_cells_.f90:100); node_topology (database.f90:632-661) is used only in some places; only embedded plates check the rule (database_build_embedded_plates_.f90:171-185). Corrected: session 1 wrongly said labels need not be sorted or contiguous.
mesh_handoff.mixing_types: several *ELEMENT blocks of different types allowed; at a shared node the dof list of every element must be a leading part of the longest one (database.f90:682-722), e.g. U1,U2 + U1,U2,PW or U1,U2 + U1,U2,R3 ok; PW-only P elements cannot share nodes with u-p elements
mesh_handoff.ndim: global: 3 as soon as one element type has ndim 3 (scanning_for_numbers_.f90:217); no per-element check of mixed 2D/3D types
mesh_handoff.orphan_nodes: every defined node must belong to at least one element, otherwise stop (database.f90:1791-1801)
mesh_handoff.parts: if used: same order of *PART and *INSTANCE, one *NODE per part, nodes of every part numbered from 1 in input order (relabel_parts then makes labels equal positions, read_part_.f90:276-282), names prefixed '<instance>.', labels of parts >= 2 renumbered (see model.md)
mesh_handoff.recommended: flat model (no *PART); one *NODE block; node labels 1..N in ascending order without gaps (required, see labels); element labels 1..M in definition order recommended (required by embedded-plate splitting, src/database/database_build_embedded_plates_.f90:156-185)
mesh_handoff.serendipity: BI-QUADRATIC adds nodes with labels max_label+1, +2, ... at positions n_def_nodes+1, +2, ... (database.f90:2031, 2233-2243); label = position only if the defined labels are 1..N without gaps
mesh_handoff.sets: write *ELSET/*NSET explicitly (ELSET= on *ELEMENT and NSET= on *NODE are ignored); use NSET=/ELSET= keys, not NAME=; avoid option substrings in names

Values in the library: 2-node beam 3, 3-node beam 21, tri3 5, tri6 22, quad4 9 (u-U and u-p-U quads: 7 POLYGON), quad8 23, quad9 28, tet4 10, tet10 24, hex8 12, hex20 25, hex27 33 (src/database/library_elements_*.txt).

format_details.duplicates: variables are canonicalised (S==STRESS, E==STRAIN) and written once per frame (895-978); node-card variables -> PointData, element-card variables -> CellData; CONTACT* in an element card are written as PointData if not already requested in a node card (793-816).
format_details.point_data_attribute: <PointData Vectors="Displacement"> if U requested, <CellData Scalar="Materials"> (non-standard attribute name) (647-660, 818-825)
format_details.pvd: ASCII XML <VTKFile type="Collection" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian">; one <DataSet timestep="T" part="0" file="<job>-out/<vtm>"/> per frame, T = total time cdb%time (cdb%time0 for iinc==0), list-directed real format (compiler dependent) (VTK_type.f90:1405-1406, VTK_write_results_.f90:151-157; strings_.f90:157-167). The file is rewritten and valid after every frame.
format_details.vtm: ASCII XML vtkMultiBlockDataSet version 1.0: Block 0 name='Model elements' with DataSet name='<d>D elements' file=<basename>; Block 'Embedded interaction regions' with sub-blocks 'Embedded region <i>' (DataSets 'Beam', 'Interaction surface') and 'Embedded plate <i>' (VTK_write_results_.f90:1135-1191). File paths are basenames relative to <job>-out/.
format_details.vtu_ascii: UnstructuredGrid version 0.1 LittleEndian; one Piece; Points Float64 3 components written with g14.6 (6 significant digits; z=0 in 2D) (VTK_write_points_.f90:64-76); Cells: connectivity Int32 0-based, offsets Int32, types UInt8 (I0) (VTK_write_cells_.f90:96-116); real DataArrays Float64 g14.6 except TEMP/DTEMP/TEMP_RATE/RFL with es25.16e3 (16 decimals) (VTK_write_DataArray_.f90:107-113); every Float64 header carries RangeMin/RangeMax (123-128); Int32 arrays written with g14.6 (integer I14); UInt8 set arrays with ComponentName<i> attributes (221-224, 403-426). Values are separated by blanks; Fortran drops the 'E' for 3-digit exponents (e.g. 0.123457-100).
format_details.vtu_binary: same XML with header_type="UInt64", every DataArray format="appended" offset=..; after </UnstructuredGrid> '  <AppendedData encoding="raw">' + LF + '_' followed by the blocks in offset order, each = UInt64 byte count + raw little-endian data (Float64 / Int32 / UInt8) (VTK_type.f90:1125-1137,1159-1164; VTK_AppendedData_type_.f90:139-175; VTK_write_DataArray_.f90:246-398). Offsets advance by 8+nbytes. No compression, no base64.
